title: armeria maritima subsp. pungens
intro: Armeria maritima subsp. pungens, commonly known as dwarf sea thrift, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Plumbaginaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Armeria maritima subsp. pungens include expectorant and bronchodilator effects, which help relieve coughs and congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
